candidates.title: Inventory and capacity reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide inventory and capacity reports available for daily use.
candidates.source_quote: Inventory and capacity reports are used daily

candidates.title: Financial reports for directors
candidates.statement: The system shall provide financial reports suitable for director-level users.
candidates.source_quote: Financial report needs are understood at the director level

candidates.title: Cross-branch comparison reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide cross-branch comparison reports to compare metrics across branches.
candidates.source_quote: Need for cross-branch comparison reports

candidates.title: Report queue visibility
candidates.statement: The system shall provide visibility into the report queue and status of queued reports.
candidates.source_quote: Report queue visibility is important

candidates.title: Pre-defined executive reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide pre-defined board and executive reports.
candidates.source_quote: Board/executive reports need to be pre-defined

candidates.title: Data quality reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide data quality reports to identify issues in the data.
candidates.source_quote: Data quality reports are needed

candidates.title: Staff card-swipe login
candidates.statement: The system shall support staff login via card swipe.
candidates.source_quote: Staff login needs (card swipe)

candidates.title: In-transit item reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide in-transit item reports to support delivery coordination.
candidates.source_quote: In-transit item reports are critical for delivery coordination

candidates.title: Missing/damaged item reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide missing and damaged item reports at the branch level.
candidates.source_quote: Missing/damaged item reports are needed per branch

candidates.title: Weeding reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide weeding reports to support collection maintenance.
candidates.source_quote: Weeding reports are frequently used

candidates.title: Shelf space utilization reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide shelf space utilization reports.
candidates.source_quote: Shelf space utilization reports are important

candidates.title: Demographic analysis reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide demographic analysis reports to support program planning.
candidates.source_quote: Demographic analysis for program planning

candidates.title: Support consortium scale
candidates.statement: The system shall support a library consortium with 286 locations, 17 million annual circulations, and purchasing/processing over 900,000 items per year.
candidates.source_quote: support a library consortium with 286 locations, 17 million annual circulations, purchasing and processing over 900,000 items per year

candidates.title: Online-hours report processing
candidates.statement: The system shall allow searches and report processing during open hours without disrupting other system functions.
candidates.source_quote: searches and reports can be processed during open hours without disrupting other system functions

candidates.title: Background processing and queuing
candidates.statement: The system shall provide background processing and queuing for report generation to prevent slowing the circulation client.
candidates.source_quote: background processing/queuing to prevent report generation from slowing down the circulation client
candidates.priority_signals: concern about report processing during peak hours

candidates.title: Linux or Solaris server support
candidates.statement: The system shall operate on a Linux or Solaris server.
candidates.source_quote: shall operate on a Linux or Solaris server
candidates.priority_signals: [Consensus: Both Linux and Solaris are acceptable]

candidates.title: Web or Windows client access
candidates.statement: The system shall be accessible through a web browser or a Windows-compatible client.
candidates.source_quote: shall be accessible through a web-browser or a Windows-compatible client
candidates.priority_signals: critical - some prefer browser-based, others client

candidates.title: Browser compatibility
candidates.statement: If web-browser based, the system shall be accessible through Microsoft Internet Explorer v6.0 and later and Mozilla Firefox v2.0 and later.
candidates.source_quote: be accessible through Microsoft Internet Explorer (v.6.0 and later) and Mozilla Firefox (v.2.0 and later)
candidates.priority_signals: need to support both IE and Firefox; IE6 is still common

candidates.title: Assistive technology accessibility
candidates.statement: The system shall be accessible with screen-reading software, screen-magnification software, and other assistive technologies (e.g., JAWS, NVDA, ZoomText) and shall comply with Section 508.
candidates.source_quote: accessible with screen-reading software, screen-magnification software, and other software programs designed to increase accessibility
candidates.priority_signals: Section 508 compliance is mandatory; legal requirement

candidates.title: Relational database backend
candidates.statement: The system shall use a fully relational database back-end.
candidates.source_quote: shall use a fully relational database back-end

candidates.title: Standards-compliant HTML output
candidates.statement: The system shall produce standards-compliant (valid) HTML for all web output including reports, help, and UI components.
candidates.source_quote: shall produce standards-compliant HTML

candidates.title: Development and training environments
candidates.statement: The system shall provide development and training environments and shall support migration of configurations, report templates, and configurations to a production environment (export/import).
candidates.source_quote: provide a development and training environment with the ability to migrate configurations to a production environment
candidates.priority_signals: need to export/import report templates and configurations

candidates.title: Role-based access control
candidates.statement: The system shall control user rights and privileges through security groups and/or roles that allow access control for individuals, workgroups, and arbitrary staff groups.
candidates.source_quote: User rights and privileges will be controlled through security groups and/or "roles"
candidates.priority_signals: flexible role-based access control is essential

candidates.title: Non-interference with OPAC
candidates.statement: The management processes shall not constrain functionality or features of the Online Public Access Catalog (OPAC) module.
candidates.source_quote: These requirements shall not constrain functionality or features of the Online Public Access Catalog (OPAC) module

candidates.title: Data specifications documentation
candidates.statement: The software developer shall provide complete data specifications for authority records, bibliographic records, order records, item records, hold/request records, and other records maintained or accessed by the system.
candidates.source_quote: provide complete data specifications for authority records, bibliographic records, order records, item records, hold/request records

candidates.title: Process flow documentation
candidates.statement: The software developer shall provide a thorough high-level description of major processes, including bibliographic record import and export, validation of bibliographic records against authority sources, and standard reports.
candidates.source_quote: provide a thorough high-level description of major processes, including bibliographic record import and export, validation ... and standard reports
candidates.priority_signals: Process flow documentation helps staff understand how data moves

candidates.title: Online hierarchical help
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an online, hierarchical, cross-linked HTML help system that describes and illustrates all system functions and offers context-sensitive help.
candidates.source_quote: provide an online, hierarchical, and cross-linked help system in HTML that describes and illustrates all system functions

candidates.title: Error reporting and feedback
candidates.statement: The system shall provide thorough high-level error reporting and feedback and shall allow low-level query-specific feedback for Local and Global System Administrators from the front-end interface.
candidates.source_quote: provide thorough high-level error reporting and feedback and shall allow low-level query-specific feedback for Local and Global System Administrators from the front-end interface
candidates.priority_signals: When reports fail, staff need to understand why

candidates.title: Enterprise-level system membership
candidates.statement: The system shall be part of an enterprise-level Library Automation System.
candidates.source_quote: Management Processes are part of an enterprise-level Library Automation System

candidates.title: Centralized deployment for multiple locations
candidates.statement: The system shall be consolidated at a central location and accept input and provide services to multiple locations.
candidates.source_quote: are consolidated at a central location, and accept input and provide services to multiple locations

candidates.title: Network connectivity for centralization
candidates.statement: The system shall operate in a centralized environment and requires reliable network connectivity between the central servers and multiple locations.
candidates.source_quote: Centralization enables consistent reporting but requires good network connectivity

candidates.title: Depend on ILS data structures
candidates.statement: The system shall rely on the data structures and functionality of an enterprise-level Library Automation System, including Acquisitions and Cataloging modules.
candidates.source_quote: rely on the data structures and functionality of an enterprise-level Library Automation System, including Acquisitions and Cataloging modules
candidates.priority_signals: The data we report on comes from the ILS
